svg.aria-label: Stays on your PC: Audio (memory only by default); Transcripts (only if you save); Settings, logs, speed test; Models (downloaded, never uploaded); Phone app: no INTERNET permission. Network, only when you act: Model download in setup; Installers and Python packages; Update check (off with TLWU_OFFLINE=1); Report buttons: you review and submit; Nothing about you or your usage. No telemetry. A network guard blocks other connections while tlwu runs.
